metadata.documentation: These data are the results of high resolution simulations with the Community Earth System Model, version 1.3 (CESM1.3). These data form the basis of a publication analyzing machine learning based-detection of atmospheric rivers and associated precipitation. The CESM1.3 data include simulations with historical (years 2000-2005), RCP2.6 (years 2006-2015), and RCP8.5 (years 2086-2100) climate forcing. The temporal resolution is 3-hourly, the horizontal resolution is 0.25 degree, and the spatial domain is global.
